title: All But Nine
summary: Read the exact words before doing any maths.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: A farmer has 17 cows. All but nine run away.
points: A farmer has 17 cows. All but nine run away.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Read slowly and notice what 'all but nine' means.
Is it nine who run, or nine who stay?
points: Read slowly and notice what 'all but nine' means.

steps.title: The method: Read it slowly
sentences: All but nine means all of them except nine.
So nine did not run away.
points: All but nine means all of them except nine.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: The number 17 was only there to tempt you to subtract.

quiz.q: A shop has 12 shirts. All but 4 are sold. How many are left?
